text: The following question stood in the name of  Ms He Ting Ru –   2 To ask the Minister for Communications and Information (a) whether the POFMA Office is taking any measures to deal with misinformation over COVID-19 and COVID-19 vaccines; and (b) if so, what are the measures being taken, bearing in mind the need to ensure that there will not be a chilling effect on legitimate concerns being raised.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: For instance, we regularly convey information and clarifications through the media, on Government websites, social media and the Gov.sg channel on WhatsApp and Telegram.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We use multiple platforms and languages to communicate essential information about the COVID-19 vaccines to all segments of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Over the past few weeks, vaccination information has been conveyed through print and broadcast interviews, as well as social media, direct messaging platforms and Gov.sg.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We are also actively monitoring for vaccine-related misinformation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: All of us have a role in stemming the spread of misinformation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We should check that the information we receive comes from reliable sources, make the effort to verify before sharing and not share unverified information.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: It is vital, especially in this time of crisis, that every one of us does the right thing.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I am just wondering as a supplementary question if some degree of benefit of doubt may be afforded to those who may unwittingly be sharing disinformation.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I have in mind Grandma who may run the risk of falling foul of POFMA because she shares reservations in a WhatsApp message she received about mRNA vaccines.
